Mindgard Raises $30M Series A Mindgard, a Boston- and London-based AI security startup, has raised $30 million in Series A funding to scale its platform for discovering, assessing, and defending against security vulnerabilities in AI models, agents, and applications. ## Investors The funding round was led by Album VC, with participation from Karma Ventures and existing investors .406 Ventures, Atlantic Bridge, IQ Capital, and Lakestar. ## Mindgard Use of Funds Mindgard plans to use the new capital to scale its product, engineering, sales, and marketing operations in order to meet significant customer demand. ## About Mindgard Founded in 2022, Mindgard provides a platform that captures and exploits security vulnerabilities within AI models, agents, and applications to help enterprises mitigate risk.
